CustomField.formula: IF( SOCTBaggageFee__c< 0, "(", "") & "$" & IF(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) / 1000000)) & ",", "") & IF(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) / 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c))), 3) & "." & IF(MOD(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) , 1) * 100 < 10, "0" & TEXT(ROUND(MOD(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) , 1), 2) * 100), TEXT(MIN(ROUND(MOD(ABS(SOCTBaggageFee__c) , 1), 2) * 100, 99))) & IF(SOCTBaggageFee__c< 0, ")", "")
CustomField.label: Baggage Fee
